propositions: Core ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, maintenance, and gate commands must migrate from imperative argv parsing to shared S2a argparse factory pattern to eliminate duplicate grammar definitions.

Each migrated command's Route must wire its parser_factory reference and its _dispatch_* handler must route through that factory, with all 49 core commands covered (metrics excluded as already migrated in S2c).
Per-family unknown-token semantics (skip via parse_known_args vs reject-with-exit-2) must be preserved exactly as pre-migration behavior, proven by negative tests per semantics class.

Router global-flag extraction (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) runs before per-command factories on pre-– segment only; per-command factories parse only the local tail and do not re-declare global flags.

Parser construction must import no domain executor or optional dependency, and real selected execution must resolve no unrelated parser factory or handler, proven by construction-exclusion probe and dispatch-isolation assertions.
